demand.derivation: R-10 and R-11: per cluster and level 10 x (ceil(4000 / G) + ceil(20000 / G) + 100), reserve levels the same; G = smaller part's cluster count

lineages.not_registered_reason: Capacity at the low levels cannot be reached without changing the difficulty. The plain and 'must include' shapes of rev2 are a few hundred items; the group-product shape that replaces them has exact support 620, 892 and 1,982 at levels 0-2 (caps 10^4..10^6, groups of at most 14..18 people); even groups of 30 people picking up to 5 (answers up to 10^10) give 9,447. Measured n_eff 613, 883, 1,957 at levels 0-2 against 22,830 (and against 11,415 as one of two members of S4). Cluster S4 continues with slot_permutations alone (a one-member cluster; the cluster count is unchanged).

Capacity and the tell, both measured. The wording and the 'exactly once / at least once' ambiguity are fixed, and the printed clue set is minimal (and every all-but-one set leaves at least 4 numbers), but (a) the number of distinct puzzles is bounded by the 90 two-digit and 900 three-digit secrets times their clue sets: measured n_eff of the final shape (M = 6,000) is 82, 1,956, 2,023, 1,682, 1,735, 177, 190 at levels 0-6 against 22,830; the version without the 'at least 4 left' condition reached 1,787, 6,486, 6,546, 14,398, 14,443, 11,628, 11,507 (three necessary clues from level 0) and an earlier one with two necessary clues 1,905-26,110; no level-meaningful version reaches the demand at levels 0-2, so there is no 'partial level' set; (b) with three or more necessary clues the first two printed clues still leave only a few numbers, so 'the smallest number meeting the first two clues' scores +0.12 to +0.28 (requiring 8 left over by every all-but-one set made a valid draw take seconds at levels 5-6; 4 was kept). The builder stays on file as an attempt.

Capacity and the memorised-triple tell cannot both be fixed. Integer right triangles are sparse: 294 with hypotenuse <= 400, 1,981 with <= 2,000, 3,414 with <= 3,200 (exact enumeration). The mixture of the five shapes needs about 8,300 triangles for the demand with margin (n_eff = 3.57 x the number of triangles), which needs hypotenuse <= about 7,000 (squares of 5 x 10^7) even at level 0, so no level-meaningful widening exists. Measured n_eff of the primitive-first attempt: 345, 704, 1,066, 1,431, 1,743, 2,098, 2,491 (levels 0-6) against 22,830. The catalogue of the 16 primitive triples scaled still scores +0.23 at level 0 (+0.13 at level 1). The builder stays on file as an attempt.

note: Fix round 3 after AUDIT3_M1 and LEAD_RULINGS_3. New revisions (ids M1.<stem>_r3) in new files; nothing enters core.REGISTRY; no model was run; no solver other than the implementer's brute-force self-check (m1_fix3_verify.py). Numbers are MEASURED on generator output unless marked ANALYTICAL (demand, exact support). n_eff is a SAMPLED lower bound. Nothing here is registered, approved or scored.

seeds.note: throwaway integers, not registered study seeds

working_target_note: Shortcut target (working, not a registered bound): every rule within +-0.10 of the base rate (the held-out most frequent answer), two-sided, at every level; measured values are reported as they are, including those above the target.
